brief:
Israeli occupation forces raided the town of Silwad east of Ramallah on Wednesday evening, the Shehab Wire reported. The military incursion marked an escalation in activity across the region during the same period.

Settlers launched concurrent raids in several locations across the eastern and northeastern parts of the governorate. The dual operations by occupation forces and settler groups targeted multiple areas within Ramallah's periphery.
